text: CTR-47 applies to VEND-47. The clause imposes a $38,400 penalty for delays exceeding 14 days unless an official regional Force Majeure weather waiver was active on the breach date. The breach date is 2026-09-24. Force Majeure logs for APAC-SOUTH on 2026-09-24 show wind_knots: 22, waiver_declared: false, event: normal. No waiver was active, so the penalty applies.
